overlap_group: Attacking Piece Threats vs King Attackers
nature_of_overlap: When pieces advance toward the enemy king, Attack scores threats against defender pieces while KingSafety scores zone convergence.
resolution_verdict: Legitimate complementary: Attack now measures explicit tactical victim threats (10 params), while KingSafety measures proximity to the king. Keep distinct.
